title: In 1628, a Giant Warship Sank After Sailing Just 1,300 Meters

scenes.text: In 1628, a giant warship sank after sailing just thirteen hundred meters.
It was the Vasa, on its very first voyage out of Stockholm.
A gust of wind tipped it over, and a second gust pushed it further.
Water rushed in through the open gun ports on the lower deck.
It sank in thirty-two meters of water, and thirty people died.
It was raised in 1961, after three hundred and thirty-three years under the sea.

description:
In 1628 the warship Vasa sank after sailing about 1,300 meters on its maiden voyage.
A gust of wind tipped it over and water poured in through the open lower gun ports. It was raised in 1961.
Would you have boarded it?
first_comment: The ship sailed about a kilometer, then spent 333 years underwater. Which wreck would you most like to see?
